It sounds like you've been putting in real effort—four gym sessions a week and multiple attempts to find something that works. That persistence matters, and the frustration you're feeling after regaining weight is completely understandable.

The honest answer is that this is a decision best made with a doctor who knows your full medical history. The newer weight-management medications do help some people, but whether they're right for you depends on factors like your health, any conditions or medications, and your specific goals—things a prescriber needs to assess directly. They can also help you weigh the benefits against side effects and costs. In the meantime, continuing your therapy and healthy habits won't hurt; they often work best alongside any medical treatment rather than as an either/or choice. Consider booking an appointment to talk it through with your physician so you can make an informed choice together.
